card.name: Loop diuretic names and lead-ins
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside loop diuretic names (furosemide, bumetanide, ethacrynic acid), and linking words like "other" or "with" leading into "diuretics". Seen in diuretic label text.

modes.label: Inside diuretic names
modes.description: Partway through the names of loop diuretics such as bumetanide, furosemide and ethacrynic acid.
modes.example: bum<<et>>anide can be substituted at approximately a

modes.label: Linking word before diuretics
modes.description: A small word such as other, such or with right before the word diuretics.
modes.example: has additive effects when used with<< other>> diuretics.

modes.label: Dose range gap
modes.description: The space after a dose range start in a diuretic dosing passage.
modes.example: Onset of diuresis usually occurs at 50 to<< >>100 mg for adults.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word "loop", as in loop diuretics.
card.plain: It marks spots in diuretic text where the next word could be "loop", as in loop diuretic.
